goal: Require explicit delegation assessment for substantial work and measure whole-task outcomes.
constraints: Preserve unrelated working changes and machine state.
Do not force a worker when overhead or model fit justifies main-only execution.
Unknown usage and cost remain unknown; measurements never replace required checks.

non_goals.description: No automatic model changes, secret changes, fleet rollout or unrelated edits.

acceptance.criterion: Substantial plans require a bounded assessment and task measurements validate and persist
Full deterministic verification and independent review pass
